articles.title: BIG! Iran's 'Super Weapon', Putin's Deadly Upgrade Pummels Ukraine; Zelensky Aide Cries Foul | WATCH
articles.description: Ukraine’s ambassador to Israel, Yevgen Korniychuk, says Russia’s war against Ukraine and Israel’s conflict with Iran are part of the same broader struggle, with Iranian-made drones linking the two battlefields. Speaking to The Jerusalem Post ahead of Ukraine’s Independence Day, Korniychuk said Ukraine has been attacked by the same Iranian-made drones that Russia has deployed in the war. articles.description: Yemen’s Iran-backed Houthi movement has claimed two drone strikes against Saudi Arabia, targeting Najran Airport and an Aramco facility in the southern Najran region near the Yemeni border. Houthi military spokesperson Yahya Saree said the group carried out the operations as tensions between the Houthis and Saudi Arabia continue to escalate.
